result:
All verified working. Here's the summary of the audit and the fixes made.

## What was wrong

This is a company that pivoted from **InboxZap** (email-cleanup tool) to **Lumina** (AI meeting assistant), and the migration left the site in a broken, half-done state:

- **Blog posts were orphaned.** The 12 old posts rendered fine at their direct URLs, but the blog index was a client component fetching `/api/posts` — a route that doesn't exist (404, confirmed on the live site too). No page anywhere linked to an individual post. That's exactly why GSC shows them with thousands of impressions but position 42–58: they're surviving on old crawl memory alone and were on a path to falling out of the index entirely.
- **All 12 old posts are topically dead** for the current product (inbox-zero, Gmail filters, bulk-delete — nothing to do with meeting transcription). No amount of on-page optimization would make that traffic convert; the right move was to retire them, not polish them.
- **Sitewide broken link**: nav + footer linked to `/faq` on every page; it 404'd.
- **Stale brand leak**: root layout still shipped InboxZap title/description/OG metadata.
- `/features` and `/pricing` had no source in the repo at all.
- Sitemap listed pages that don't exist and omitted every real blog post.
- `og:image` pointed to a 404.
- The `inboxzap` brand query still pulls real clicks at ~position 4 — worth protecting explicitly, not silently dropping.

## What I changed

- **`app/layout.tsx`** — removed stale InboxZap metadata, set Lumina-consistent defaults with a title template.
- **`app/page.tsx`** — per-page metadata, Organization/SoftwareApplication/FAQPage JSON-LD, and a real `#faq` section (the redirect target that never had content) — including a direct "What happened to InboxZap?" answer to capture and convert residual brand-term searchers.
- **`app/features/page.tsx`, `app/pricing/page.tsx`** (new) — were missing from the repo entirely; added with metadata + Product schema on pricing.
- **`lib/posts.ts`** (new) — 5 new posts targeting real Lumina-relevant queries (AI meeting notes, meeting transcription software, writing better minutes, meeting overload, async standups), replacing the dead inbox-cleanup topics.
- **`app/blog/page.tsx`** — now a server component with real `<a href>` links to posts (fixes the orphan-page bug).
- **`app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx`** (new) — SSR per-post pages with `generateMetadata`, canonical URLs, and Article JSON-LD.
- **`app/sitemap.ts`** — now generated from the same post data, listing exactly the real indexable URLs.
- **`next.config.js`** — added a 301 from all `/blog/post-:id` URLs to `/blog`, consolidating any residual link equity instead of leaving them 404 or orphaned.
- **`app/not-found.tsx`** (new) — branded 404 instead of the generic Next.js error page.

Verified via `next build` + `next start`: all pages 200 with correct metadata/JSON-LD, old post URLs 301 to `/blog`, `/faq` now resolves to real content, sitemap is accurate.

**Left as follow-ups (out of scope for this pass):** a real `/img/og-lumina.png` asset needs to be added by design (currently 404s — I can't fabricate a meaningful image file), and `next@14.2.5` has a known security advisory worth a separate upgrade.
